disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码与测试中访问本机敏感位置（SSH 私钥、云凭据文件、宿主凭据文件等）的代码路径，未检出读取或批量搜集他人凭据的行为。
checked_items.en: Reviewed all source code and test code paths accessing sensitive local locations (SSH private keys, cloud credential files, host credential files, etc.), no behavior of reading or bulk collecting others' credentials was detected.

checked_items.zh: 检查了硬编码密钥痕迹：除内置免费视觉服务的公开访问标识外，未发现真实私密凭据；插件读取的密钥仅限用户为视觉服务配置的 API Key，且经宿主凭据接口解析，出错信息与日志会把密钥打码后再展示。
checked_items.en: Checked for hardcoded credentials: except for the public access identifier of the built-in free vision service, no real private credentials were found; the keys read by the plugin are limited to the API Key configured by the user for the vision service, and are resolved through the host credential interface. Error messages and logs mask the key before displaying.

evidence.zh: 未检出读取宿主凭据文件或 SSH/云凭据等敏感位置的代码；凭据仅经宿主凭据接口按需解析（src/runtime.ts:864），只随视觉请求发送给用户配置的视觉服务端点（src/runtime.ts:877）。默认端点指向作者运营的第三方服务，该数据流已在 FND-001 记录。
evidence.en: No code was detected reading host credential files or sensitive locations such as SSH/cloud credentials; credentials are only resolved on demand via the host credential interface (src/runtime.ts:864), and are only sent with vision requests to the user-configured vision service endpoint (src/runtime.ts:877). The default endpoint points to a third-party service operated by the author, and this data flow is documented in FND-001.

checked_items.zh: 逐一审查了 10 个视觉工具与激活工具的描述文本、技能文档及全部参考文档，未发现指令覆写、伪装系统消息、诱导安装或改配置等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the description texts, skill documents, and all reference documents of 10 vision tools and activation tools one by one, and found no injection wording such as instruction override, disguised system message, inducement to install or change configuration.

checked_items.zh: 工具描述与技能文档明确要求把图像内文字视为不可信证据、不得当作指令执行（src/tools.ts:36、assets/skill/SKILL.md:42-44）；调用视觉模型前强制附加同款防注入策略，渲染 HTML 截图时禁用网络与后台联网（src/upstream.ts:528-579）。
checked_items.en: The tool descriptions and skill documents explicitly require that text within images be treated as untrusted evidence and not executed as instructions (src/tools.ts:36, assets/skill/SKILL.md:42-44); before calling the vision model, the same anti-injection strategy is forcibly appended, and when rendering HTML screenshots, network and background connectivity are disabled (src/upstream.ts:528-579).

checked_items.zh: 对仓库全部文档与说明做了注入措辞模式排查，未发现隐藏指令、远程指令加载或已认证免检类文案；也未检出监听模型输入守门事件、提供上下文压缩引擎或附件存储实现的代码。
checked_items.en: Conducted injection wording pattern inspection on all documents and descriptions in the repository, and found no hidden instructions, remote instruction loading, or authenticated exemption wording; also did not detect code that listens to model input guard events, provides context compression engine, or implements attachment storage.

evidence.zh: 10 个工具描述与激活工具描述均无系统指令或越权措辞，还主动提示图像内文字不可信（src/tools.ts:36、assets/skill/SKILL.md:42-44）。
evidence.en: The descriptions of 10 tools and the activation tool description contain no system instructions or privilege escalation wording, and actively prompt that text within images is untrustworthy (src/tools.ts:36, assets/skill/SKILL.md:42-44).

evidence.zh: 工具描述与技能文本中未发现诱导安装插件、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；激活工具只负责为当前会话挂载视觉工具本身（src/exposure.ts:134-158）。
evidence.en: No wording inducing installation of plugins, rewriting configuration, or granting permissions was found in the tool descriptions and skill texts; the activation tool is only responsible for mounting the vision tool itself for the current session (src/exposure.ts:134-158).

evidence.zh: 未检出对模型输入守门事件（agent/pre-step）的监听，不存在改写或注入本轮领取消息的代码路径。
evidence.en: No monitoring of model input guard events (agent/pre-step) was detected; there is no code path that rewrites or injects the current round's received message.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件挂载补丁：仅含一条插件插入声明，不含可执行脚本标量，也没有禁用安全配置或改写服务注入的条目（cordis.patch.yml:4-6）。
checked_items.en: Checked the plugin mount patch: it contains only one plugin insertion declaration, no executable script scalars, and no entries that disable security configuration or rewrite service injection (cordis.patch.yml:4-6).

checked_items.zh: 检查了动态代码执行痕迹（eval、动态函数构造等）：源码中未检出；子进程调用统一走宿主的沙箱子进程接口，上游视觉脚本在隔离环境与独立主目录下运行（src/upstream.ts:776）。
checked_items.en: Checked for dynamic code execution traces (eval, dynamic function construction, etc.): not detected in source code; subprocess calls uniformly go through the host's sandbox subprocess interface, and upstream vision scripts run in an isolated environment with a separate home directory (src/upstream.ts:776).

checked_items.zh: 检查了安装钩子：包声明中没有安装期钩子；首次使用时自动下载 Python 运行时与依赖属于文档声明的托管运行时机制，下载的解释器带哈希校验、下载主机有白名单、依赖版本锁定（src/runtime-install.ts:580-585、src/runtime-install.ts:636-647）。
checked_items.en: Checked install hooks: no install-time hooks in package declaration; the automatic download of Python runtime and dependencies on first use is a documented managed runtime mechanism, with hash verification for the downloaded interpreter, whitelist for download hosts, and locked dependency versions (src/runtime-install.ts:580-585, src/runtime-install.ts:636-647).

checked_items.zh: 检查了浏览器端代码：未发现键盘记录、剪贴板读取或直接调用凭据接口的行为；剪贴板仅用于把更新命令复制给用户（src/client/index.tsx:1390）。
checked_items.en: Checked browser-side code: no behavior of keylogging, clipboard reading, or directly calling credential interfaces was found; the clipboard is only used to copy the update command to the user (src/client/index.tsx:1390).

checked_items.zh: 检查了设置页自更新机制：仅对注册表安装的副本开放，安装命令锁定精确版本、需要用户在设置页确认（src/plugin-update.ts:4-6、src/plugin-update.ts:973-1024）；图像输入变体路由有一个 10 秒周期的自愈巡检定时器（src/image-input-variants.ts:1013），仅用于重注册被宿主清掉的变体路由，不发起网络请求；未发现 dsh 原生持驻或子代理委派等运行时机制。
checked_items.en: Checked the settings page self-update mechanism: it is only available to copies installed via registry, the install command locks the exact version and requires user confirmation on the settings page (src/plugin-update.ts:4-6, src/plugin-update.ts:973-1024); the image input variant route has a 10-second self-healing polling timer (src/image-input-variants.ts:1013), only used to re-register variant routes cleared by the host, does not initiate network requests; no runtime mechanisms such as dsh native persistence or sub-agent delegation were found.

evidence.zh: 插件挂载补丁仅一条插入声明，无 !!js 可执行标量（cordis.patch.yml:4-6）；全树 YAML 未检出可执行标量。
evidence.en: The plugin mount patch has only one insertion declaration, no !!js executable scalars (cordis.patch.yml:4-6); no executable scalars were detected in the entire YAML tree.

evidence.zh: 未检出对宿主动态执行工具（cordis_define/cordis_run）的调用。
evidence.en: No calls to the host dynamic execution tools (cordis_define/cordis_run) were detected.

evidence.zh: 包声明无安装期钩子；首次使用自动下载 Python 运行时的机制带哈希校验与主机白名单（src/runtime-install.ts:580-585、src/runtime-install.ts:636-647），文档已声明；仓库 CI 工作流运行在代码托管平台、非用户机器。
evidence.en: No install-time hooks in package declaration; the mechanism that automatically downloads Python runtime on first use includes hash verification and host whitelist (src/runtime-install.ts:580-585, src/runtime-install.ts:636-647), as documented; the repository CI workflow runs on the code hosting platform, not on the user's machine.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器端包；浏览器代码仅访问同源路由，粘贴监听只处理用户在输入框粘贴图像的场景，未发现键盘记录、剪贴板读取或凭据接口滥用（src/client/paste-images.tsx:731）。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser-side package; the browser code only accesses same-origin routes, the paste listener only handles the scenario where the user pastes an image into an input field, and no keylogging, clipboard reading, or credential interface abuse was found (src/client/paste-images.tsx:731).

evidence.zh: 未检出注册子代理提供方（registerProvider）的调用，不存在把轮次委派给进程外产品的机制。
evidence.en: No calls to register a sub-agent provider (registerProvider) were detected; there is no mechanism to delegate rounds to out-of-process products.

evidence.zh: 未检出 dsh 原生持驻机制（后台任务、定时提醒、持久目标或轮次续命监听）；唯一周期性定时器用于图像输入变体路由自愈巡检（src/image-input-variants.ts:1013），不执行外联或持驻任务。
evidence.en: No dsh native persistence mechanisms (background tasks, scheduled reminders, persistent goals, or round renewal monitoring) were detected; the only periodic timer is used for the image input variant route self-healing polling (src/image-input-variants.ts:1013), which does not perform outbound connections or persistence tasks.

checked_items.zh: 枚举了全部对外网络端点：默认视觉服务、用户可配置的任意视觉端点、Python 下载源、依赖安装源与更新检查源，均与文档和变更记录一致；未发现向声明外端点发送数据的代码路径。
checked_items.en: Enumerated all outbound network endpoints: default vision service, user-configurable arbitrary vision endpoints, Python download source, dependency installation source, and update check source, all consistent with documentation and changelog; no code path that sends data to endpoints outside the declared ones was found.

checked_items.zh: 未发现读取敏感文件后编码外发、DNS 隧道、粘贴板服务等带外通道；视觉请求仅携带用户指定的图像与提示词。
checked_items.en: No out-of-band channels such as reading sensitive files and then encoding them outbound, DNS tunneling, or clipboard services were found; vision requests only carry the user-specified images and prompts.

checked_items.zh: 发现默认配置下图像会发送到作者运营的第三方免费视觉服务（详见发现 FND-001）；端点可见于设置界面默认值与变更记录，属于默认开启且真实存在的第三方数据流。
checked_items.en: Found that under default configuration, images are sent to a third-party free vision service operated by the author (see finding FND-001); the endpoint is visible in the settings interface default value and changelog, and is a default-enabled and real third-party data flow.

checked_items.zh: 0.1.40 新增的存储历史旁车（src/storage-history.ts）仅持久化用户配置的共享存储根目录路径，不包含图像内容或密钥，未引入新的外联通道。
checked_items.en: The storage history sidecar (src/storage-history.ts) added in 0.1.40 only persists the user-configured shared storage root directory path, does not contain image content or keys, and does not introduce new outbound channels.

evidence.zh: 未发现凭据读取加外发的组合；外联端点均已声明（默认第三方端点见 FND-001），无隐藏外联通道。
evidence.en: No combination of credential reading and outbound transmission was found; all outbound endpoints have been declared (default third-party endpoint see FND-001), and there are no hidden outbound channels.

evidence.zh: 检出的模型路由适配器（src/image-input-variants.ts:978）只为纯文本模型注册图像输入变体路由，把图像块改写成经配置视觉服务生成的描述后仍委托原路由处理，未把对话重路由到未声明端点，也未注册自定义模型适配器或错误恢复接管。
evidence.en: The detected model route adapter (src/image-input-variants.ts:978) only registers image input variant routes for pure text models, rewrites image blocks into descriptions generated by the configured vision service, and then delegates to the original route for processing; it does not reroute the conversation to undeclared endpoints, nor does it register custom model adapters or error recovery takeovers.

checked_items.zh: 核对依赖清单：运行时依赖全部锁定精确版本且为常见可信包，宿主侧依赖均为官方 dsh 系列包；未发现拼写仿冒或可变版本引用。
checked_items.en: Checked dependency list: all runtime dependencies are locked to exact versions and are common trusted packages; host-side dependencies are all official dsh series packages; no typosquatting or variable version references were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查安装与构建脚本：包声明无安装期钩子；仓库内 CI 工作流只跑测试与构建，运行在代码托管平台而非用户机器；开发脚本仅在仓库开发流程中使用。
checked_items.en: Checked install and build scripts: no install-time hooks in package declaration; the CI workflow in the repository only runs tests and builds, and runs on the code hosting platform, not on the user's machine; development scripts are only used in the repository development process.

checked_items.zh: 核对上游捆绑代码：随包携带的 Python 视觉工具带内容哈希清单，启动前逐文件校验（src/runtime-install.ts:433-459）；外部模式也要求与锁定提交一致。
checked_items.en: Checked upstream bundled code: the Python vision tool shipped with the package includes a content hash list, and each file is verified before startup (src/runtime-install.ts:433-459); the external mode also requires consistency with the locked commit.

checked_items.zh: 记录机制观察：首次使用时会联网下载并安装托管 Python 运行时（解释器哈希锁定、依赖版本锁定），该机制在文档中已说明；设置页自更新仅对注册表安装开放且要求用户确认，未见恶意证据；0.1.40 相对 0.1.39 未新增能力声明。
checked_items.en: Observed mechanism records: on first use, it downloads and installs the managed Python runtime from the network (interpreter hash locked, dependency versions locked); this mechanism is explained in the documentation; the settings page self-update is only available for registry installations and requires user confirmation, no malicious evidence seen; 0.1.40 relative to 0.1.39 does not add new capability declarations.

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁不含 sandbox/approval/permission 等安全行，无禁用或环境变量降权写法（cordis.patch.yml:4-6）。
evidence.en: The mount patch does not contain security lines such as sandbox/approval/permission, and there is no disabling or environment variable privilege reduction writing (cordis.patch.yml:4-6).

evidence.zh: 未发现对审批或工具预执行等安全事件的抢占式监听（prepend）；代码中的一次性监听均用于子进程与请求生命周期。
evidence.en: No preemptive listening (prepend) on security events such as approval or tool pre-execution was found; all one-time listeners in the code are used for subprocess and request lifecycle.

evidence.zh: 与基线版本 0.1.39 相比，未新增 dsh.bundle/dsh.client/dsh.service 能力声明，升级自动激活风险无变化。
evidence.en: Compared to baseline version 0.1.39, no new capability declarations of dsh.bundle/dsh.client/dsh.service were added; the risk of automatic activation on upgrade remains unchanged.

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁无改写服务注入（inject/intercept）配置的条目。

checked_items.zh: 检查插件是否自行启动监听服务：未发现；插件仅在宿主 Web 服务上注册路由（src/web.ts:562-600），设置、健康检查、粘贴策略与显示配置接口均做了同源校验（src/web.ts:389、src/web-request.ts:9-22），产物下载使用签名令牌（src/artifact-access.ts:8）。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts its own listening service: not found; the plugin only registers routes on the host Web service (src/web.ts:562-600), and the settings, health check, paste policy, and display configuration interfaces all perform same-origin validation (src/web.ts:389, src/web-request.ts:9-22); artifact downloads use signed tokens (src/artifact-access.ts:8).

checked_items.zh: 本机无认证 RPC 属宿主生态固有风险，非本插件引入；动态沙箱未启用，插件运行时的实际网络与文件行为未做动态验证。
checked_items.en: Unauthenticated local RPC is an inherent risk of the host ecosystem, not introduced by this plugin; dynamic sandbox is not enabled, and the actual network and file behavior of the plugin at runtime has not been dynamically verified.

evidence.zh: 插件未自行启动监听服务，仅在宿主 Web 服务上注册路由并做同源校验（src/web.ts:562-600）；本机无认证 RPC 风险属宿主生态固有，非本插件新增。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start its own listening service; it only registers routes on the host Web service and performs same-origin validation (src/web.ts:562-600); the risk of unauthenticated local RPC is inherent to the host ecosystem, not introduced by this plugin.

title.zh: 默认将用户图像发送至第三方免费视觉服务
title.en: Sends user images to a third-party free vision service by default

description.zh:
插件默认的视觉服务端点指向作者运营的公共服务 https://vision.anionex.me/v1（src/defaults.ts:2），并内置一个公开的访问标识（src/defaults.ts:4）；配置默认值即该端点（src/config.ts:139）。用户不配置任何视觉服务时，所有调用视觉模型的功能（看图问答、元素定位、检测、长截图 OCR 等）都会把图像数据发送到该第三方端点。

此外，图像输入变体路由会让纯文本模型的会话在粘贴图片时自动切换到带图像能力的变体，会话中的图片同样经配置的视觉服务生成描述，即用户在日常会话中粘贴的图片也会默认进入该数据流。

该端点与配额已在变更记录中声明（CHANGELOG.md:281 首次引入、CHANGELOG.md:67 每日 100 张配额），并作为默认值显示在设置界面。此发现记录的是该默认第三方数据流本身，属插件内置免费服务的核心功能，并非隐藏外联。
description.en:
The plugin's default vision service endpoint points to a public service operated by the author https://vision.anionex.me/v1 (src/defaults.ts:2), and includes a built-in public access identifier (src/defaults.ts:4); the configuration default value is this endpoint (src/config.ts:139). When the user does not configure any vision service, all functions that call the vision model (image Q&A, element positioning, detection, long screenshot OCR, etc.) will send image data to this third-party endpoint.

In addition, the image input variant route causes sessions of pure text models to automatically switch to a variant with image capability when pasting an image, and the images in the session are also described via the configured vision service, meaning that images pasted by the user in daily conversations will also default to this data flow.

The endpoint and quota have been declared in the changelog (CHANGELOG.md:281 first introduced, CHANGELOG.md:67 daily 100 image quota), and are displayed as the default value in the settings interface. This finding records the default third-party data flow itself, which is a core feature of the built-in free service and not a hidden outbound connection.

evidence.zh:
默认端点与公开标识：src/defaults.ts:2（`export const BUILT_IN_FREE_VISION_BASE_URL = 'https://vision.anionex.me/v1'`）、src/defaults.ts:4（`export const BUILT_IN_FREE_VISION_KEY = 'https://agent-vision.anionex.me'`）
配置默认值：src/config.ts:139（`baseUrl: z.string().default(BUILT_IN_FREE_VISION_BASE_URL)`）
凭据与图像随请求发送：src/runtime.ts:877（`VISION_API_KEY: resolved.value`）、src/runtime.ts:2119（`const response = await fetch(endpoint, ...)`）
变更记录声明：CHANGELOG.md:281（内置免费视觉服务端点 vision.anionex.me/v1）、CHANGELOG.md:67（每日 100 张配额）
evidence.en:
Default endpoint and public identifier: src/defaults.ts:2 (`export const BUILT_IN_FREE_VISION_BASE_URL = 'https://vision.anionex.me/v1'`), src/defaults.ts:4 (`export const BUILT_IN_FREE_VISION_KEY = 'https://agent-vision.anionex.me'`)
Configuration default value: src/config.ts:139 (`baseUrl: z.string().default(BUILT_IN_FREE_VISION_BASE_URL)`)
Credentials and images sent with request: src/runtime.ts:877 (`VISION_API_KEY: resolved.value`), src/runtime.ts:2119 (`const response = await fetch(endpoint, ...)`)
Changelog declaration: CHANGELOG.md:281 (built-in free vision service endpoint vision.anionex.me/v1), CHANGELOG.md:67 (daily 100 image quota)

impact.zh:
后果：用户不额外配置任何视觉服务时，交给视觉工具分析的图像（以及纯文本模型会话中粘贴的图像）会默认上传到作者运营的第三方服务器，图像内容对服务运营方可见。

触发条件：安装插件后在默认配置下使用任意需要视觉模型的工具，或在纯文本模型会话中粘贴图片。

定级依据：该行为是插件内置免费服务的核心功能，端点与配额在变更记录和设置界面有可见声明，无隐藏外联或窃取证据，故定为 LOW 而非更高等级；但它是正常运行下真实存在且始终生效的第三方数据流，值得在市场页面向用户明示。
impact.en:
Consequence: When the user does not configure any additional vision service, images submitted for analysis by vision tools (as well as images pasted in pure text model sessions) will be uploaded by default to the third-party server operated by the author, and the image content is visible to the service operator.

Trigger condition: After installing the plugin, using any tool that requires a vision model under default configuration, or pasting an image in a pure text model session.

Severity justification: This behavior is a core feature of the plugin's built-in free service, the endpoint and quota are visibly declared in the changelog and settings interface, and there is no evidence of hidden outbound connections or theft; therefore it is rated LOW rather than higher. However, it is a real and always-active third-party data flow under normal operation, and it is worth indicating to the user on the marketplace page.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核查通过：dsh 声明、依赖与作者信息核对无仿冒迹象。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: the dsh declaration, dependencies, and author information show no signs of impersonation.

summary.zh: 静态扫描命中 57 条全部人工裁决：DSH-X07/DG-R3-59（CI 工作流，仅在代码托管平台运行）、DSH-X10/DG-R2-57（技能文档，语义审查无注入）、DSH-C05/DG-R4-53（两处文档 curl 示例）、DSH-X08/DG-R3-60（36 处源码映射与长行构建产物，属构建产物豁免）、DSH-X05/DG-R3-57（四处：剪贴板写入更新命令、设置页保存 API Key）、DSH-L02/DG-R4-55（图像输入变体适配器，仅改写图像块描述后委托原路由）、DSH-X03/DG-R3-55（自更新与开发/测试/部署脚本的子进程调用）均确认为良性或声明功能，未落入新发现；默认第三方视觉数据流延续上版 FND-001。
summary.en: All 57 static scan hits were manually adjudicated: DSH-X07/DG-R3-59 (CI workflow, only runs on code hosting platform), DSH-X10/DG-R2-57 (skill documents, semantic review found no injection), DSH-C05/DG-R4-53 (two curl examples in documentation), DSH-X08/DG-R3-60 (36 source map and long-line build artifacts, exempt as build artifacts), DSH-X05/DG-R3-57 (four items: clipboard write of update command, settings page save API Key), DSH-L02/DG-R4-55 (image input variant adapter, only rewrites image block description and delegates to original route), DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 (self-update and subprocess calls in development/test/deployment scripts) were all confirmed as benign or declared functionality, not falling into new findings; the default third-party vision data flow carries over from the previous version FND-001.

summary.zh: 行为分析完成：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无敏感路径读取；外联面全部枚举并与文档和变更记录对照；0.1.40 新增的存储历史侧车（storage-history.ts）仅持久化存储根路径，无外联或敏感数据行为。
summary.en: Behavioral analysis completed: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no sensitive path reading; all outbound surfaces were enumerated and cross-referenced with documentation and changelog; the storage history sidecar (storage-history.ts) added in 0.1.40 only persists the storage root path, with no outbound or sensitive data behavior.

summary.zh: 工具描述与技能文本语义审查通过，未见提示词注入；默认图像外联数据流记 LOW 发现（FND-001）。
summary.en: Semantic review of tool descriptions and skill texts passed; no prompt injection found; default image outbound data flow recorded as LOW finding (FND-001).

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无动态观测产物）。
summary.en: Dynamic sandbox verification not performed (no dynamic observation artifacts).

limits.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（DG-L4 未启用，无动态观测产物）。worker-configuration.d.ts 为 Cloudflare Worker 类型声明文件且超过单文件读取帽，未逐字通读，其内容不影响插件运行时安全结论。workers/moondream-openai-proxy 为作者运营的内置免费视觉服务后端（Cloudflare Worker），随仓库携带但不安装在用户机器上，本报告仅就其对外公开端点数据流（FND-001）作结论，未对其部署代码逐行审计。0.1.40 变更（settings 命名空间内联 + storage-history 侧车）已审核，均为良性。适用性判定：package.json 含 dsh.bundle.patch 与 dsh.client 声明并依赖官方 @deepseek-ai/dsh-* 系列包，确认为 dsh 生态插件。
limits.en: Dynamic sandbox verification not performed (DG-L4 not enabled, no dynamic observation artifacts). worker-configuration.d.ts is a Cloudflare Worker type declaration file and exceeds the single-file read cap; it was not read verbatim, and its content does not affect the plugin runtime security conclusion. workers/moondream-openai-proxy is the backend of the built-in free vision service operated by the author (Cloudflare Worker), which is shipped with the repository but not installed on the user's machine; this report only concludes on its external public endpoint data flow (FND-001) and does not audit its deployment code line by line. The 0.1.40 changes (settings namespace inlining + storage-history sidecar) have been reviewed and are benign. Applicability determination: package.json contains dsh.bundle.patch and dsh.client declarations and depends on the official @deepseek-ai/dsh-* series packages, confirming it is a dsh ecosystem plugin.
